title: 第五章 奖励 特殊天赋第六章 宋青书 舔狗不得好死
content_zh:
殿门大开。
宋远桥等二代子，还有宋青书等三代弟子纷纷进了大殿。
他们很疑惑。
这个时候，寿宴已经准备妥当，就等张真人出面。
结果却被召唤到了大殿中，还发现有一位陌生的少年，竟然站在了师尊旁边。
宋远桥欲言又止，却被张真人摆手阻止。
“将你们召集过来，是有一件事要说。”张真人指着旁边的林凡道，“他是林凡，父母遭劫，孤身一人，今日上山，我们爷俩很是投缘，有感这是上天送给老道的福气，就收他为关门弟子。”
此言一出，众人哗然。
您老九十九了，还收弟子？
还是收一个毫无根基、年岁又大的青年为弟子？
闹哪样呢？
宋远桥嘴角动了动，却没敢辩驳。
他可是知道师尊的性子，平时什么事儿也不在意，可一旦决定，绝不能违逆。
“远桥，准备准备，你们也做个见证！”张真人坐在了主位上。
“是！”宋远桥恭敬应道。
简单准备了一下。
林凡来到张真人身前，行弟子大礼，最后奉上了拜师茶。
“从今天开始，你就是老道的第八弟子，也是关门弟子！”张真人接过茶杯，喝了一口，忍不住笑道，“九十九收关门弟子，还是老天送来的，哈哈，不错不错，当真妙哉。”
他格外开心。
林凡却身子一僵。

在张真人应下后，他听到了只有他能听到的声音。
【恭喜林凡，成功加入武当派，成为武当开派祖师张三丰弟子】
【你完成任务，下发奖励】
【恭喜你林凡，获得天赋能力：知识就是力量】
【现在融合】
【提醒：降临者只有第一次降临世界才会获得奖励】
【提醒：奖励高低，会随着任务完成时间、加入势力强弱、拜师之人身份、地位、实力等有巨大差别】
【格外提醒：你一日之内，加入当前世界顶级宗门，并拜师世界之内武林泰山北斗、实力最强之人为师，奖励已经增幅至极限】
【重要提醒：‘知识就是力量’这一天赋能力，蕴藏着无上伟力，有至强的破限潜能，请深入开发】
完成任务的诸多隐藏条件关乎奖励高低等，这并不出他的意料。
任务，奖励。
自然会有好坏。
content_en:
The palace door is wide open.
Song Yuanqiao and other second generation disciples, as well as Song Qingshu and other third generation disciples entered the hall one after another.
They were confused.
At this time, the birthday banquet has been prepared and they are waiting for Master Zhang to come forward.
As a result, he was summoned to the main hall and found a strange young man standing next to his master.
Song Yuanqiao hesitated to speak, but Master Zhang waved his hand to stop him.
"I summoned you here because I have something to say." Zhang Zhenren pointed at Lin Fan next to him and said, "He is Lin Fan. His parents were robbed and he was alone. Today we went up the mountain. We got along very well. We felt that this was a blessing from God to the old Taoist, so we accepted him as a closed disciple."
As soon as this statement came out, everyone was in an uproar.
You are ninety-nine years old and you are still accepting disciples?
Or should you accept an old young man with no foundation as your disciple?
What's going on?
Song Yuanqiao's mouth moved, but he did not dare to argue.
He knew his master's temperament, and he usually didn't care about anything, but once he made a decision, he could never disobey it.
"Yuanqiao, get ready, you can also be witnesses!" Zhang Zhenren sat on the main seat.
"Yes!" Song Yuanqiao responded respectfully.
Just prepared a little bit.
Lin Fan came to Zhenren Zhang, bowed as a disciple, and finally served apprenticeship tea.
"From today on, you are the eighth disciple of the old Tao, and also the closed disciple!" Master Zhang took the tea cup, took a sip, and couldn't help laughing, "Ninety-nine closed disciples are sent by God, haha, not bad, not bad, really wonderful."
He was extremely happy.
Lin Fan froze.
After Zhang Zhenren agreed, he heard a voice that only he could hear.
[Congratulations to Lin Fan for successfully joining the Wudang Sect and becoming a disciple of Zhang Sanfeng, the founder of the Wudang Sect]
[You complete the task and the reward will be distributed]
[Congratulations to Lin Fan, you have obtained the innate ability: Knowledge is power]
【Now merge】
[Reminder: The descendant will only receive rewards when he descends into the world for the first time]
[Reminder: The level of rewards will vary greatly depending on the completion time of the task, the strength of the joining force, the identity, status, and strength of the apprentice]
[Special reminder: If you join the top sect in the world within one day and become a disciple of Beidou, the most powerful martial artist in the world, the reward has been increased to the limit]
[Important reminder: The innate ability of ‘knowledge is power’ contains supreme power and has the strongest limit-breaking potential. Please develop it in depth]
Many of the hidden conditions for completing the mission were related to the level of rewards, which was not surprising to him.
Tasks, rewards.
Naturally there will be good and bad.
